sources.title: Gemma 2 model card - Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: Gemma is a family of lightweight, state-of-the-art open models from Google, built from the same research and technology used to create the Gemini models. They are text-to-text, decoder-only large language models, available in English, with open weights for both pre-trained variants and instruction-tuned variants.

sources.title: Turkish Gemma 9b T1 — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A Gemma 2 9B model fine-tuned specifically for Turkish language tasks, giving it noticeably stronger fluency and coherence in Turkish compared to the base model. It handles Turkish grammar and vocabulary with more natural output, though its capabilities are bounded by the 8K context window and its specialization means it may underperform on non-Turkish tasks.
